notes: Native firmware 0.1.37 — the stale ready-flag: a FAILED handshake never cleared s_display_ready, so after a TFT re-delivery (the display reboots itself) the post-write handshake failure left the flag true from the pre-delivery handshake — every revival path (the reprobe, the housekeeping) gates on !ready and was skipped forever: the freshly rebooted display sat on the authored splash (the NSPanel Core logo) with nobody to navigate it. The failure now clears the flag (the revival engages within 30 s and navigates), and the delivery's success path navigates immediately via the new after_handshake export. Carries all prior fixes.

bug_fixes: 0.1.7/0.1.8: the boot reset reason is visible on the panel's web UI after every boot; TFT updates are refused while the display is not responding.
